environment_model._purpose: PRIMARY: how the environment works. The per-state pixel tables below are DERIVED from these laws, not independent facts. A law is only useful if it predicts behaviour in states never visited -- test it that way.

L1_coordinate_transform.law: send = capture * 1.25  (engine renders 1024x768, client is 1280x960; incoming click coords are scaled by 0.8)
L1_coordinate_transform.scope: expected GLOBAL - every state, including unvisited ones
L1_coordinate_transform.evidence: predicted row1 needs send(625,300) BEFORE running it; ran it; row1 selected. Also retro-explains (797,450)->row2 and (797,555)->row3.
L1_coordinate_transform.status: CONFIRMED IN-GAME 2026-07-24 -- the generalisation test PASSED. Close button at capture(335,376); L1 predicted send(419,470); that click dismissed the alertbox. Falsification control (identical walk, click removed, equal wait) left the box OPEN. L1 is a real law, not scenario_select trivia.

L2_click_protocol.law: Before each click, move to and post WM_LBUTTONUP at the PREVIOUS click position. Otherwise the first click grabs a control that is never released and every later click is swallowed.
L2_click_protocol.scope: expected GLOBAL - it is an input-protocol property, not panel-specific
L2_click_protocol.evidence: same battery: 1/3 clicks landed before the fix, 3/3 after (5180 / 79455 / 4338 px, reproduced exactly). Releasing at the NEW position was tested and FALSIFIED.
L2_click_protocol.status: confirmed in scenario_select; in-game click landed with the protocol in force

L3_injection_channel.law: press:<ldl>/select:<ldl>,<idx> call InjectPress/SelectItem in C++ - no cursor, no coords, no grab, and works regardless of scroll position or visibility.
L3_injection_channel.scope: any control with an LDL path; CTP2_LISTBOX is atomic so rows/scrollbar have NO path and need L1+L2 clicks

L4_observation_decoder.law: pixel delta between consecutive shots classifies the outcome

table.0: input never landed / modal ate it

L5_slic_persistence.law: CTP2 serializes compiled SLIC into saves; a loaded save ignores edited .slc until /reloadslic. A NEW game compiles fresh.
L5_slic_persistence.scope: governs which entry path can test a SLIC change at all

L6_binary_identity.law: The exe under test must be asserted, not assumed - build.bat builds only Final-SDL (ctp2.exe); the launcher re-stages ctp2-dbg.exe over manual copies every run.

L7_input_reach_by_surface.law: Which input channels reach a control depends on the SURFACE, not on CTP2 globally.

L8_capture_health.law: A readable capture requires TWO things: SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software (+SDL_FRAMEBUFFER_ACCELERATION=0) and the nointromovie arg. Both are now baked into uiwalk.Game.launch.
L8_capture_health.why: The default accelerated SDL backend creates a surface GDI PrintWindow cannot read (61,040 -> 151,173 non-black pixels on an identical frame when forced to software). Separately, civapp.cpp:594 plays a ~40s cinematic over the whole client; civ3_main.cpp:1104 clears g_useIntroMovie on the nointromovie arg.
falsified_root_causes: Primary-monitor orientation / display mode. REAL mechanism (display.cpp display_EnumerateDisplayModes reads display 0 only, so userprofile ScreenRes* is honoured only if it names a primary-display mode) but it explains window SIZE ONLY. A legal, honoured 1024x1280 window was still black.
Stash position. -1500,-1500 gives byte-identical output to -32000,-32000.
A modal error dialog. Only SDL_app / MSCTFIME UI / IME exist on the PID.
L8_capture_health.golden_geometry_CORRECTED_20260725: RETRACTED: an earlier note here claimed the goldens were authored at a 1280x960 landscape client and were therefore stale, and told the future not to re-baseline. BOTH premises are false. MEASURED: every golden region fits inside 1024x768 (110+800=910, 70+610=680), and full-frame template matching scores EXACTLY 1.000 for main_menu / new_game / scenario_select / pack_contents. The goldens were never stale. The real defect was in match_template: it cropped the search area to exactly the region, which is exactly the golden size, leaving ZERO slack, so any translation scored ~0. Fixed with pad=320 -> 0/6 became 4/5 with four checks at 1.000.
L8_capture_health.letterbox_is_PER_SURFACE: The engine draws its fixed UI inside whatever legal window size the primary display allows, and the offset DIFFERS BY SURFACE. Measured at a 1024x1280 client: menus sit at (+2,+264); the in-game magic alertbox sits at (+2,+8) (anchor match 1.000). Do NOT hardcode one offset. Asserts must ask "is this UI present", not "is it at this exact pixel" -- that is what the search padding buys.

coord_rule.rule: The engine scales incoming click coords by 0.8. To hit something SEEN at capture (cx,cy) you must SEND (cx*1.25, cy*1.25).
coord_rule.evidence: Predicted row1 needs (625,300); ran it; row1 selected. Also explains (797,450)->row2 and (797,555)->row3, i.e. x=797 scales to 638 which is INSIDE the list, never on the scrollbar.
coord_rule.capture_is_1to1_with_logical: Yes - LDL geometry (ScenarioWindow 640x480 centered -> listbox logical x224-788,y187-565) matches measured capture x222-784,y175-559. Only the SEND path is scaled.

methods.press: injection hook: write 'press:<ldl path>' to H:\mom_inject.txt, PostMessage WM_APP+100 -> aui_Button::InjectPress. No coords. MOST RELIABLE for buttons.
methods.select: injection hook: 'select:<ldl path>,<index>' -> aui_ListBox::SelectItem. Index-based, no coords, no scrolling needed. Bounds-guarded since 2026-07-24.
methods.click: PostMessage WM_LBUTTON* with SEND coords (capture*1.25). Required for things with no LDL handle, e.g. the scrollbar trough.

click_multi_fix.problem: Only the FIRST synthetic click registered; every later click was swallowed. This also explains the 36-click grid sweep that showed 0 responses - its first click landed on empty space and burned the one working click.
click_multi_fix.cause_thesis: The first click grabs a control that is never released, so later clicks are delivered to the grabbed control and do nothing visible.
click_multi_fix.fix: Before each click, move to and post WM_LBUTTONUP at the PREVIOUS click position, then click. Releasing at the NEW position does NOT work (tested and falsified).
click_multi_fix.evidence: Same step battery: before fix 1 of 3 clicks landed; after fix 3 of 3 landed (select row -> scroll -> select row post-scroll).
click_multi_fix.parked_gap: After Back -> reopen of the scenario panel, the next click still does nothing. Unexplained. Workaround: use press:/select: injection, which is unaffected.
